subject: ROOT CAUSE phone T1/T3/vhost 'guest memory exhausted': 4KiB mprotect on 16KiB XNU pages
body: Verified in XNU bsd/kern/kern_mman.c mprotect(): 'if (user_addr & vm_map_page_mask(user_map)) return EINVAL'. iOS arm64 page=16384; emu/n2a32_mem.c mprotected at guest 4KiB granularity -> every non-16K-aligned guest map (vpud at 0x40080000) failed -> alloc 0 -> 'guest memory exhausted'. The 4GiB+64KiB reservation itself succeeds (mmap OK at 0x280000000; T1 r1 (aligned)=0, r2 (b+4GiB-4KiB, unaligned)=-1). FIX (owner opus-guestmem, files emu/n2a32_mem.c, emu/test_v02/t_core.c, ios/n2vcd_selftest.c): host protection applied per host page as union of the 4KiB guest page states (any RW->RW, else RO->R, else NONE); per-4K state table unchanged; base+addr fast path and C ABI unchanged; env N2A32_MEM_GRANULE=16384 simulates iOS on Linux. Limitation: on 16K host a free/RO 4K guest page sharing a host page with an RW one does not fault. Selftest T1 now logs errno + largest reservation. opus-perf: no change needed in n2a32_core.c / n2a32_fast.h. Tests + iOS build in progress.
